name: Fast Stutter
description: The speed knob near its top with the intensity full: as fast as the cell can follow, which is why it is shallower than slower settings.

name: Gentle Shimmer
description: A low intensity: the lamp burns dimly and the level dips by a couple of decibels once a swing. A movement felt more than heard.

name: Slow Pulse
description: The speed knob at its bottom, some 3.7 Hz, and fairly deep, for chords left to ring.

name: Surf Throb
description: Deep and choppy at some 5 Hz: the throb of the surf records, the level falling fast as the lamp flashes and climbing back slowly.

name: Swamp Shuffle
description: Slow, under a shuffle, the intensity at three quarters: the tremolo of the swamp-blues and roots records.

name: Tine Piano Throb
description: A tine piano through an amplifier's tremolo, at a medium speed and moderate depth.
